newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia, Italian banks sign 420 bln lira credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Russia, Italian banks sign 420 bln lira credit pact.

text.p: A consortium of Italian banks, led by investment bank IMI and Mediobank, signed a 420 billion lira credit framework agreement with Russia on Thursday, Vneshekonombank, which represents Russia in the deal, said.
The five to 8.5 year credit will be used to buy equipment, state-owned Vneshekonombank said in a statement.
Other banks in the consortium include Mediocredito Centrale, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro Spa and Interbanca, it said.
